# Little Nine Heaven SoCal

> Traditional internal kung fu, tai chi and qigong taught by Sifu Ajay Kumra in San Diego County (Santee, California). Classes are private and by appointment only, one-on-one or in small groups; the first class is a free introductory class. Sifu Ajay also travels worldwide to teach private lessons at students' locations. He trained under Master James McNeil of the Little Nine Heaven lineage.

## School
- [Home](https://l9hkungfu.com/): overview, frequently asked questions and contact form
- [Instructor: Sifu Ajay Kumra](https://l9hkungfu.com/instructor): background and teaching approach
- [Lineage](https://l9hkungfu.com/lineage): Lushan Daoren, Grandmaster Chiao Chang-Hung (32nd generation) and Master James McNeil (33rd generation)

## Arts taught
- [Hsing-I (Xing Yi Quan)](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-hsing-i)
- [Chen Tai Chi (Taijiquan)](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-chen-tai-chi)
- [Ba Kua (Baguazhang)](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-ba-kua)
- [Chi-Kung (Qigong) and Taoist healing](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-chi-kung)
- [Little Nine Heaven](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-little-nine-heaven)
- [Shih Shui (bone marrow washing)](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-shih-shui)
- [Splashing Hands](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-splashing-hands)
- [Tzu Men Chuan (Zimenquan)](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-tzu-men-chuan)
- [Iron Hand](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-iron-hand)
- [Taoist Meditation](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-taoist-meditation)
- [Taoist Lovemaking](https://l9hkungfu.com/system-taoist-lovemaking)
